summary: The Pay control was a plain div, so it had no button role, could not be reached by keyboard, and Enter in the card fields did not submit. It is now a native submit button with the same styling, so it is exposed as button "Pay $54.00" and Enter submits the form.

accepted.why: Native submit button gives role, name, focusability and Enter-key implicit submission; also removes the invalid div inside p that produced empty paragraphs.
